units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:1">Mikv. VIII, 1</cite> <he>חוץ למ׳</he> (Var. <he>לפתח</he>) outside of the (town) gate; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:1">Tosef. ib. VI, 1</cite> (R. S. to Mikv. l. c. <he>פתח</he>).—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite> <he>מִפְתַּח שפתיו וכ׳</he> the opening of his lips is blessing and peace.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:2">Sabb. XV, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 111b:8">111ᵇ</cite>) <he>מ׳ חלוקה</he> (Y. ed. <he>מפתחי</he>) the neekhole of her shirt; Y. ib. 15ᵇ; a. e.—Pl. <he>מִפְתָּחִים</he>, constr. <he>מִפְתְּחֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:27">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יה״ר דומה … בין שני מ׳ הלב</he> man’s evil inclination resembles a fly and is seated between the two valves of the heart; Yalk. Koh. 979; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:1">Yalk. Gen. 38</cite>.—<he>מ׳ חלוק</he>, v. supra.
